name: Merchant Kalé
quote: I am Kalé. Purveyor of fine goods. ...A nomadic merchant. If you happen to be on the road, well, we might cross paths again.

name: Sorceress Sellen
quote: I am Sellen, a sorceress, as you can see. Perhaps you'd like to study glintstone sorcery? Though I was exiled from the Academy of Raya Lucaria, my knowledge remains intact.

name: Smithing Master Hewg
quote: I'm a prisoner, and these are my chains. I'm trapped by the Hold, undying, smithing for you fools. That's all there is to it.

name: Roderika
quote: Everyone who came with me. They crossed the sea for me. They fought, for me. Heh... Only to have their arms taken. Their legs taken. Even their heads... taken. Taken and stuck to the spider.

name: Thops
quote: For a small donation, I'd be happy to share my knowledge. Though I must confess, I was only a bluntstone at the Academy.
location: Church of Irith, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Enia
quote: The Fingers guide us all. And you Tarnished, you are here to take, are you not? Bring me Great Runes, and I will read their power.

name: Miriel, Pastor Of Vows
quote: I welcome you to the Church of Vows. I am Miriel, steward of this sacred chamber. Here we preserve both incantations and sorceries, for all things can be conjoined.
location: Church of Vows, Liurnia of the Lakes
role: Pastor of Vows / Incantation & Sorcery Tutor

name: War Counselor Iji
quote: Well, look at you. We don't receive many visitors. I am Iji, war counselor to Lady Ranni.
location: Road to the Manor, Western Liurnia

name: Sorcerer Rogier
quote: The pleasure's mine. Rogier's the name. A sorcerer, as you might have guessed. I'm investigating the source of the thorns and Deathroot.

name: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman
quote: I feel its stench on you... death. Feed it to me. Bring more... Deathroot.

name: Boc The Seamster
quote: Hm? Oh, yes, I remember. Some clod turned me into a tree. You're the kind soul who gave me a roll, aren't you?
location: Boc's Tree, Limgrave / Coastal Cave / Roundtable Hold

name: Brother Corhyn
quote: I teach incantations, the strength granted us by the Two Fingers, and explore the secrets of the Golden Order.

name: D, Hunter Of The Dead
quote: Those Who Live in Death must be extinguished. There is no other way. Be on your way, unless you share my conviction.
role: Hunter of Those Who Live in Death

name: Knight Bernahl
quote: Let me ask you something. Are you here in the Lands Between to take up the fight? Does your faith in the guidance of grace hold firm, despite the collapse of the Golden Order?
role: Recusant Knight / Ash of War Master

name: Pidia, Carian Servant
quote: Please, can you offer poor ill-starred Pidia... some mercy? I only care for the royal family's puppets.
location: Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Imprisoned Merchant
quote: Well, well. A customer in this godforsaken place? Buy what you like, it makes no difference to me.

name: Melina
quote: Have you heard of the finger maidens? They serve the Two Fingers, offering guidance, and aid, to the Tarnished. But you, I am afraid, are maidenless. I can play the role of maiden.
location: Sites of Grace across the Lands Between

name: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
quote: Be on your way. You are a tarnished, are you not? Then be on your guard against the Bloody Fingers. They hunt their own kind.
location: Seaside Ruins / Murkwater Coast / Raya Lucaria Academy / Second Church of Marika

name: Iron Fist Alexander
quote: I am Alexander, also known as the Iron Fist. And as you can see, I'm stuck here. Give me a good wallop from behind with something nice and big!
location: Northern Stormhill / Liurnia / Radahn Festival / Mt. Gelmir / Crumbling Farum Azula

name: White-faced Varré
quote: Are you familiar with grace? The golden light that gives life to you Tarnished. You may also behold its golden rays pointing in a particular direction at times. That is the guidance of grace.
location: The First Step, Limgrave / Rose Church, Liurnia
role: Servant of Mohg, Lord of Blood

name: Renna
quote: I was entrusted with this, for thee. By Torrent's former master. Take it, and ring the bell to summon spirits.

name: Fia
quote: Great champion, would you allow me to hold you, but briefly? Receive a Baldachin's Blessing in exchange for a sliver of your vigor.

name: Edgar
quote: Even if the castle should fall, as commander, I must remain. I cannot abandon Castle Morne until the treasured sword is reclaimed from the servants.

name: Irina
quote: My good father secreted me out the castle, but decided himself to stay. He says it's his duty, as commander. I... I fear for father's life.

name: Kenneth Haight
quote: Hello? Is anybody there? Someone who might be interested in rescuing the great Kenneth Haight? Servant of the true Order, and celebrated repudiator of the false!

name: Queen Marika
quote: Hear me, Demigods. My children beloved. Make of thyselves that which ye desire. Be it a Lord. Be it a God. But should ye fail to become aught at all, ye will be forsaken amounting only to sacrifices.
role: Sovereign of the Lands Between / Vessel of the Elden Ring

name: Knight Diallos
quote: The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood. I, Diallos, swear to deliver that promise. Yet look at me, cowering here while Lanya lies dead.
location: Roundtable Hold / Academy Gate Town / Volcano Manor / Jarburg

name: Frustrated Spirit
quote: All I wanted was to fight. To fight, as a warrior, to the last... So, why? Why, O guidance of grace, will this door not open?

name: Twin Maiden Husks
quote: ... ... (Offer bell bearings to expand their shop inventory)

name: Frustrated Spirit
quote: All I wanted was to fight. To fight, as a warrior, to the last... So, why? Why, O guidance of grace, will this door not open?

name: Gideon Ofnir
quote: As a Tarnished who wishes to stand before the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord, I am accumulating knowledge. To be all-knowing. Welcome to the Roundtable Hold.
role: Leader of the Roundtable Hold / The All-Knowing

name: Patches
quote: I'm Patches. Patches the Untethered. I was just minding my own business, honest! Water under the bridge, eh? Let's be friends!
location: Murkwater Cave / Scenic Isle / Volcano Manor / Shaded Castle

name: Hyetta
quote: Hello? Is someone there? My name is Hyetta, and I'm journeying in search of the distant light. If I might be so bold as to ask... would you donate any Shabriri grapes in your possession to me?
location: Lake-Facing Cliffs / Purified Ruins / Bellum Highway / Frenzied Flame Proscription
role: Blind Maiden / Herald of the Three Fingers

name: Palm Reader
quote: You, please, I can read them. Your fingers, please, your fingers... Ah, the wisdom of the Two Fingers is profound!
location: Bridges and crossroads across the Lands Between

name: Nepheli Loux
quote: Be proud. You were a fine warrior. Your only mistake was your choice of master. I am Nepheli Loux, warrior.
location: Stormveil Castle / Roundtable Hold / Village of the Albinaurics / Stormveil Throne

name: Rya
quote: A pleasure to meet you, brave Tarnished. My name is Rya, scout for Volcano Manor. My Lady Tanith bids you welcome.

name: Tanith
quote: I am Tanith, the proprietress of this house. An honour to have you. Do you wish to join us in standing against the Erdtree?

name: Ranni The Witch
quote: I am the witch Ranni. I stole Death long ago, and search now for the dark path. Wilt thou walk with me?

name: Gatekeeper Gostoc
quote: You'd be well advised to avoid the main gate. It's tightly guarded by grim old stormveilers. Best sneak in through the breach on the side.

name: Primeval Sorcerer Azur
quote: ... ... (Silently imparts the primeval glintstone sorcery Comet Azur)
role: Grand Master of the Primeval Current

name: Dung Eater
quote: I told you not to disturb me. I can smell the stench of the living on you. Leave me be, or I'll defile your corpse.

name: Preceptor Seluvis
quote: I don't know what it is the mistress sees in a provincial Tarnished like you, but since we have the misfortune of serving the same Lady, I ask that you kindly try not to drag us all down with you.
role: Preceptor of Sorcerous Arts / Puppet Crafter

name: Blaidd
quote: The name's Blaidd. I'm looking for a man who goes by 'Darriwil'. He fled after committing betrayal, and I intend to bring him down.
location: Mistwood Ruins / Forlorn Hound Evergaol / Siofra River / Redmane Castle

name: Gowry
quote: The rotting sickness that afflicts Millicent has no cure. When the Erdtree flourished, even the demigods could not stave off its effects, despite their nigh godhood.
role: Sage of Gowry's Shack / Servant of Rot

name: Millicent
quote: I would rather trust you than simply continue to spoil from within. With this needle in hand, perhaps I can trace the path of Malenia.
location: Church of the Plague / Gowry's Shack / Erdtree-Gazing Hill / Windmill Village / Haligtree

name: Bloodhunter Raz
quote: ...I've still my pride. I'm not going out like a complete monster. (Pre-release Network Test designation for the Bloody Finger Hunter).

name: Latenna
quote: Foul Tarnished, what do you want? Ah, you carry the right half of the secret medallion. Take me to the consecrated snowfield, to the Apostate Derelict.

name: Albus
quote: Please, no. Dear me! I haven't a clue. No secrets lie with me, not a one... Ah, you are not one of Cursemonger's brutes? Take this, the Haligtree Secret Medallion.

name: Ensha Of The Royal Remains
quote: ... ... (Silent attendant to Gideon Ofnir; strikes once the secret medallion is acquired)

name: Shabriri
quote: May chaos take the world! May chaos take the world! Throw yourself into the flames of frenzy, and burn away all that divides and distinguishes!
location: Zamor Ruins, Mountaintops of the Giants
role: Avatar of Frenzied Chaos (Possessing Yura's Body)

name: Witch-hunter Jerren
quote: Brave champion, you have our gratitude. General Radahn has found honorable death at your hands. Now, I have duties of my own to see through.
location: Redmane Castle / Witchbane Ruins / Raya Lucaria Grand Library

name: Goldmask
quote: ... ... (Silently contemplates the Golden Order, pointing his finger toward the Erdtree)
location: Forest-Spanning Greatbridge / Leyndell / Mountaintops of the Giants
role: Transcendent Scholar / Author of the Perfect Order Rune

name: Blackguard Big Boggart
quote: Never met someone with a taste for prawns I couldn't trust. We'd make good mates, I reckon.

name: Three Fingers
quote: ... ... (Embraces the Tarnished with the scorching flame of frenzy)
location: Frenzied Flame Proscription (Cathedral of the Forsaken)

name: The Great-jar
quote: ... ... (Silently watches over the Great-Jar's Colosseum trial)
